title: 2026-09-09 New 911 System Implementation Progress and Challenges
conciseSummary: The meeting on September 9, 2026, focused on the implementation status of the new 911 system, which is currently live following successful completion of most tests for various call types. However, issues persist with missing or misconfigured contact entries and ongoing connectivity problems, which are affecting call recording verification. The team has completed several tasks, including verifying audio functionality and conducting inbound and outbound transfer tests, but several pending tasks remain, such as fixing contact entries and confirming call recordings. Key blocking issues include intermittent network connectivity and complications in matching call recordings, with resolutions involving collaboration among team members. The discussion highlighted the importance of effective communication, checklist utilization for vendor verification, and the need for further digital testing. The project team is preparing to dismantle the old system once remaining issues are resolved. Action items were assigned to various team members to address these concerns swiftly.
markdown:
## Date & Time:
2026-09-09 13:07

## Attendees:
- Speaker 1 (Shaun with Resilient)
- Speaker 2 (Michael)
- Speaker 3 (Jacob)
- Speaker 4 (Tanya)
- Speaker 5 (Manny)
- Speaker 6 (Justin)
- Speaker 7 (Matt)

## Project Name:
New 911 System Implementation

## Project Status:
The project is live with most tests completed successfully. All call types (wireless, VoIP, landline, business) have been verified. Some contact entries are still missing or misconfigured, and final digital testing is ongoing. Connectivity issues and call recording verification remain to be resolved. The team is preparing to tear down the old system once remaining issues are fixed.

## Completed Tasks:
- Task 1: Verified two-way audio for wireless, VoIP, landline, and business calls.
- Task 2: Completed inbound and outbound transfer tests between multiple PSAPs.
- Task 3: Headset integrations and workstation setup completed.
- Task 4: TeamViewer remote access verified.
- Task 5: Verified CAD spill and alley spill functionality.
- Task 6: Confirmed network span mirror and port connections.
- Task 7: Conducted multiple test calls including emergency call back tests.

## Pending Tasks:
- Task 1: Fix three contact entries (Wilcox missing, Dothan and Evergreen need correction).
- Task 2: Verify call recordings and resolve issues with call ID matching.
- Task 3: Complete digital testing and confirm IRR and LTR settings.
- Task 4: Confirm and improve connectivity stability.
- Task 5: Finalize transfer list and contact entries in the system.
- Task 6: Conduct further testing on 480 and 503 call types later.
- Task 7: Verify MEVO validation and sleep settings.

## Blocking Issues:
- Issue 1: Missing or misconfigured contact entries (Wilcox missing, Dothan and Evergreen incorrectly set as directories).
  - Resolution: Admin rights to add and edit contacts; awaiting fixes from Michael and others.
- Issue 2: Spotty network connectivity causing audio hiccups and difficulty verifying recordings.
  - Resolution: Network team checking span mirrors and port connections; local recorder checks requested.
- Issue 3: Call recordings not appearing or incomplete, complicating verification.
  - Resolution: Working with JJ and Justin to confirm recording captures and call ID matching.

## Discussion Points:
- Point 1: Call Transfer Testing and Contact Management
  - Verified multiple transfers between PSAPs.
  - Identified three problematic contacts (Wilcox missing, Dothan and Evergreen misconfigured).
  - Discussed admin access for editing contacts and updating transfer lists.
- Point 2: Audio and Connectivity Issues
  - Noted intermittent audio dropouts and network latency spikes.
  - Requested local recorder checks and network span mirror verification.
- Point 3: Call Recording Verification
  - Difficulty in matching call recordings due to missing caller ID or incomplete data.
  - Coordination with JJ and Justin to improve recording capture and call ID extraction.
- Point 4: System Setup and Hardware Verification
  - Confirmed headset and workstation setup.
  - Verified network port connections and span mirror configurations.
- Point 5: Digital Testing and Next Steps
  - Ongoing digital testing with plans for 480 and 503 call tests later.
  - Monitoring emergency call back functionality.
- Point 6: Project Completion and Tear Down
  - Majority of tests completed; waiting on contact fixes before tearing down old system.
  - Final verification of IRR, LTR, and MEVO validation pending.
- Point 7: General Coordination and Communication
  - Emphasized importance of checklists for vendor verification on site.
  - Discussed communication flow for test calls and call ID tracking.

## Action Items:
- Task: Fix missing and misconfigured contact entries for Wilcox, Dothan, and Evergreen - Michael and Admin Team - ASAP
- Task: Verify and confirm call recordings and call ID matching - JJ and Justin - Ongoing
- Task: Conduct further digital testing including 480 and 503 call types - Matt and Jacob - Later today
- Task: Check local recorder for connectivity and recording issues - Tia - ASAP
- Task: Finalize transfer list and update system contact entries - Michael and Eric - ASAP
- Task: Monitor and verify IRR, LTR, and MEVO validation - Project Team - Follow-up needed
- Task: Prepare for old system tear down after contact fixes - Project Team - Pending completion of fixes
